text:
alyssa: Kicking off a mini roadshow next week to validate our console observability MVP (dashboards + trace hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics). Goal: collect customer impact votes and confirm launch gates. Who wants in for slides/demo?
julian: I can join. Can we highlight token-level cost breakdown and per-route cost attribution? Customers keep asking for model-level splits.
maria: +1 for model-level cost. Also request from compliance teams: immutable error fingerprint lists for audits.
alyssa: Plan: 3 customer sessions (30m each). Agenda: 1) quick demo 2) interactive prioritization (poll) 3) confirm acceptance criteria. Draft poll items: dashboards, trace-links-to-spans, error fingerprinting, per-tenant sampling toggle, cost-attribution widget. Thoughts?
mike: Per-tenant sampling toggle seems infra-heavy for MVP. Can we ship a read-only sampling indicator first, and treat toggles as stretch?
sam: Agree with mike. For canary/gating we should require rollout paths + automated fallback to a cheaper model variant if trace-error spikes. Also need latency SLO impact defined.
alyssa: Good call. MVP cut: shipping sampling indicator + recorded preference (controls disabled in UI). 'Full control' becomes stretch. Proposed canary gate: "trace-error rate >= 3% over baseline for 5m => auto rollback to previous model" as an acceptance test.
mike: Example gate check to include in the one-pager: ```if trace_error_rate > 0.03 and latency_p95 > 200ms:
    trigger_rollback()```
julian: Also request a trace-to-console link so support can jump from a trace into the affected user's console/session. Customers brought this up repeatedly.
maria: Customer ask: embed CPU/GPU usage summary in trace view. Might be noisy — propose a compact "top N hosts" summary widget instead of full telemetry embed.
product-bot: Reminder: customer sessions booked: acme-health (Mon 10:00), ledgerly (Tue 14:00), scaleapps (Thu 11:00).
alyssa: :thumbsup: Final ask: can engineering produce a one-page 'launch gates' doc (MVP scope, gating metrics, rollback plan) before Monday? I'll use it in the roadshow slides.
mike: I'll draft the doc (MVP scope + gating metrics + rollback plan). Ping me for specifics to include.
sam: QA note: we need a small harness to simulate cost spikes and toggled sampling to validate UI/telemetry effects.
alyssa: Thanks all — adding tasks to the sprint board and posting the poll: https://polls.redwood.sh/obs-mvp-vote
